records.text: On July 14, Erika Kirk flew by private plane to Long Beach with Katherine LoCastro and Jonathan Barcelo.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: In fact, on this July 14th episode, Charlie (Charlie Kirk) has Josh Hammer on the episode asking about the evening because that evening of July 14th, Erika Kirk, who did not attend SAS in Florida, boarded a private plane with. ... With Catherine LoCastro, again, that's Mikey (Michael McCoy)'s assistant, and she headed to Long Beach alongside Jonathan Barcello.

verification.notes: Live searches found only repetitions of Candace Owens's claim and no independently accessible flight record or primary statement confirming the July 14 private flight and passenger list.

records.text: Erika Kirk, Katherine LoCastro, Jonathan Barcelo, and Derek Neukirk stayed in Long Beach for only a few hours before returning to Scottsdale.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And Erika Kirk's personal security guard, Derek Neukirk. What are the four of them doing together? They only stayed for a couple of hours and then they returned to Scottsdale.

verification.notes: Live searches found only repetitions of Candace Owens's claim and no independently accessible flight logs or primary records confirming the four named passengers, the duration of the Long Beach stay, or the return to Scottsdale.
